## Physical-size QA — complete

All five SVGs use a 1200-unit-wide canvas and are routed at **173 mm final width**. The v1 typography floor is 15 CSS units, equivalent to **6.13 pt** at 173 mm. CI rendering fails closed below 6.0 pt.

Observed final-size metrics:

| Figure | Canvas | Minimum text | Minimum stroke |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 1200×900 | 6.13 pt | 0.45 pt |
| 2 | 1200×970 | 6.13 pt | 0.409 pt |
| 3 | 1200×960 | 6.13 pt | 0.45 pt |
| 4 | 1200×900 | 6.13 pt | 0.45 pt |
| 5 | 1200×900 | 6.13 pt | 0.409 pt |

Human visual inspection of 173-mm / 300-dpi renders confirmed no remaining text overlap or canvas clipping after the Figure-1 F-state and Figure-3 hard-contradiction label repairs. Figure-2 taxon names and Figure-4 scientific names are italicized.

## Vector-PDF production QA — complete

`export_paper1_submission_figures.py` produces vector PDFs from the same v1 SVGs. `pdfinfo` reported **490.394 pt page width** for every figure, equivalent to 173 mm. Heights follow each SVG aspect ratio.

`pdffonts` reported embedded, subsetted, Unicode-capable Liberation Sans fonts for all text-bearing PDFs (`emb=yes`, `sub=yes`, `uni=yes`), including italic faces where used. PDF version was 1.7; files were ~34–36 kB, consistent with vector rather than raster-page export.

Production evidence:
- visual-render QA run: GitHub Actions `paper1-figure-qa` run `34960221741`;
- PDF page/font inspection: run `34960401357`.

## Scientific-message QA

- **Figure 1:** five-part contract, `opening_rule_reference`, canonical/fingerprint audit identity, soft/hard state logic and explicit unresolved state retained.
- **Figure 2:** 12 held-out taxa remain the replication unit; 288/283/5 are repeated diagnostics; 0/12 exceedance result retained; q95 remains an empirical envelope.
- **Figure 3:** classical `v=0` versus `v=0.5` separation retained and labelled as established probability theory; event/function authorization remains distinct from raw occurrence matching.
- **Figure 4:** *Cremastra* and *Belonocnema* remain parallel stopping-rule systems; no focal Level-C dependency is opened.
- **Figure 5:** generalized `1-a1` and `1-a0` identities retained; zero-collapsing remains an ablation, not a detection-model competitor.

## Production conclusion

The graphical display package is ready for journal upload at the intended 173-mm width. Later production conversion must not alter labels, scientific values, candidate identities or endpoint states. If a journal system re-renders the vector PDFs, perform a final spot check only; do not redesign the scientific content.
